known_issues: Line graph x-axis shows incorrect dates (August dates in February) - likely generated programmatically rather than derived from actual user data

existing_features.title: Fix the ProfileWinLossChart component so that the x-axis dates are derived from actual match history data rather than being generated programmatically. The chart should only display dates for which real win/loss records exist, and the date range should be anchored to the current date — not a hardcoded or stale range that can show months like August when the current month is February.

projectName: Fix line graph x-axis showing incorrect dates
